description: This source file defines a React hook (`useProgressiveExpand`) and a utility function (`createProgressiveExpandController`) for managing progressive, batch-wise work processing in a React application. It employs requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback to yield control, enabling smooth UI responsiveness during batch processing tasks, such as expanding tree nodes progressively.
